global_rules.chance: A visible six-face table is authored fiction; each face equal only where explicitly die_faces. Stored cryptographically-secure server draw once per event/table, seedable in tests; no AI odds or client reroll.
global_rules.selection: Filter all eligibility/context/phase predicates, exclude active same matter/source, last4ownturns samecardtarget and repeatlimit. Uniform draw among eligible distinct card IDs. Precompute seed at turn start, log candidateIDs and rulesversion. Never reroll to punish/benefit the player.
global_rules.empty_pool: Record NO_ELIGIBLE_SCENARIO and show All clear this turn. No cash, REP, career or extra roll; do not invent a generic penalty.
global_rules.target_selection: Show actual target; choose earliest acquired eligible owned target, tie holdingID. No selecting the most costly target secretly. Marketcardtargetsall qualifyingholdings once.
global_rules.choice_ui: Voice/captions; 2-3 touchcards; show now cost, laterbindingcost, affectedrecord, chancefaceswhenapplicable, availableprotection/netcost; no requiredtyping.
global_rules.mandatory_bill: Expense debits min(AvailableCash,netexpense), creates event_payable for remainder. TaxBucket untouched. Zero interest; payable persists finalwealth once. Doesnot auto-originate loan or ordinarycreditpunishment.
global_rules.event_payable_due: Default eventbill due before next ownroll unless authoredlater. Missing due keeps it unpaid, disables new optional financed purchases until it is cleared, but does not take a whole turn or create a second moneyfine. Restriction is reason-specific and shown only in Finance/affectedquote; no tax/debtreminder.
global_rules.optional_payment: Disable unaffordable optional immediatecash choices; require atomic net-costquote after electiveprotection. Always at least one affordable/noimmediatecashresponse.
global_rules.followup_order: At start ownturn: due committedscenariocheckpoints; currenttaskresponses; movement andcentralfinance. Show story consequences without unsolicited tax/debtreminders.
global_rules.unanswered_choice: No default risky choice; session pauses/resumes. At forcedauthorizedclose, apply eachscenario declaredcost-freebranch or preserveexistingbindingclaim; no AIdecision.
global_rules.task_completion: Tap a compact authored interaction at next ownturn. Only actualcompletionpostsreward. Same task cannot award again through a curveball; missedoptional rewardisforegoneincome.
global_rules.reputation: ClampdisplayREP at0; lognegativechanges actualdelta. Victimization, medicalevents, poorluck, assetloss anddecliningunaffordablepurchases cause no automaticREPpenalty.
global_rules.company_effects: Companyvalueeffectonce/company/eventID; investorvaluesderived. Companycash/serviceexpense paidonlyby consentingauthorizedoperator; nocapitalcalltohumans or personallegalplancompanybill.
global_rules.finish: No newpurchase/task/offer. Committedmoneyoutcomessettledusingstoredresult and sourceids; pendingunearnedoffersworth0; payablescountonce; nocurrentstatus penaltywithoutauthoredcash. ThenCentralFinancefinaltaxandimmutableFinish.
global_rules.mixed_coverage: Other scopedinsurancefirst; matchinghealth/legalfeeplansecond; onechoseneligiblecareer/businessservicediscountthird; yellowtokenlastforremainingmandatoryexpense. No doubleclaim or assistanceaboveunderlyingexpense. Personallegalplannevercoverscompanybill.

pressure.financial: ratio=unpaidcashobligationsduebyownnextroll / AvailableCash. Ifdue0 steady; ifcash0 anddue>0 strained. Ratio<0.5 steady;0.5through1 tight;>1 strained; actuallypastdue separatelyoverdue. TaxBucket shownalongside asreservedcash, notspendingcash.

portal.phase: college_sim only; remaining_athletic_laps from pinned game profile, not real NCAA clock
portal.initial_state: info_or_entered; old placement retained only in information mode
portal.offer_acceptance: Show net move cost and actual guaranteed signed campaign payment; accept only if uncovered cost can be paid after same atomic signed payment. Payment is taxable NIL; expense is personal, not tax deduction. Actual amount earned as signing deliverable, not promised professional earnings. Accept one, expire others; no stacking.
portal.search_again: If no accepted offer, a second search occurs one own turn later using same table and new stored die. Information mode may stay without losing its current place. Entered mode has no guaranteed return. Return offer appears only if original place explicitly available.

followup_fit.deterministic_adjustment: If academic task was missed, cap result at middle and schedule academic repair; do not change die. Preparation opens information; it does not rig athletic outcomes.

no_placement_after_two_searches.recovery: Next own turn offers O_BALANCED by authored support referral if remaining_athletic_laps positive; player may accept or stay in education/career. No mandatory paid mentor.

portal.worst_case: Only when entered, no accepted placement after at least two searches plus the recovery checkpoint, AND remaining_athletic_laps reaches zero through normal game clock. Then set athletics_phase=ended; no additional arbitrary money fine. Career, business, study, Finance and earned contract cash continue.
portal.finish: Settle already-earned signed amounts and actual incurred expenses; pending unaccepted offers add $0. Do not roll extra searches or force worst_case just because the game ended.
portal.disclosure: Fictional timing, costs and probabilities are game-balance settings, not real NCAA transfer advice or measured likelihoods.

producer_contract.initial_profile: At start author a simulated adult college athlete, public NIL profile, shared student housing, and fictional family context. Do not infer real age, family, medical or educational records. Set phase and remaining_athletic_laps from the pinned profile. Academic risk and misconduct start false.
producer_contract.yellow_contracts: Y01/Y04/Y05/Y06/Y07/Y10 base delivery creates a completed paid invoice plus a sponsor relationship record lasting 3 own turns. Active_signed_nil_contract means a real ongoing agreement or selected follow-up, not the opening die valuation. Each optional follow-up creates signed terms, task, known due date and one obligation ID.
producer_contract.receivables: For scenario-producer testing, permit authored completed-delivery invoices with disbursement_due=current_own_turn+2. At delivery create receivable and do not also add cash. Its scheduled collection pays once. R02 sets revised_due=max(original_due,current_own_turn)+2; waiting collects at that exact source due date. Expediting replaces it with current_own_turn+1. Retarget the existing collector atomically; do not retain its old scheduled payout. Y02 collects up to15k early and reduces the same receivable. Existing yellow guaranteed base remains immediate cash and never uses this deferred mode. Add deferred invoicing only to an explicit green business/customer job or separately labeled future-payment NIL option; do not silently defer existing promised cash rewards.
producer_contract.operating_ventures: Green operating business purchase stores equipment and platform/inventory exposure tags only when its authored card supplies them. A promotion linked to that business creates the actual campaign record. Only inventory-bearing merchandising activations create inventory/order records, with inventory_unsold_value bounded by company value.
producer_contract.bookings_and_orders: An accepted event activation creates booking_id, original_payment_id, refundable_deposit and customer prepayment amounts from its actual budget and sales. Defaults are0; do not invent paid bookings or customer cash. Prepayments remain liabilities until delivery. Enable R09/R12 only after this producer is integrated.
producer_contract.partnerships: The shared venture registry stores actual contribution promises and due dates. Default none. R05 is unavailable until an actual human nonpayment or explicitly authored external NPC contribution exists. No peer misconduct is inferred from low cash.
producer_contract.representatives: Only selecting an explicitly authored representative-management contract creates representative_relationship and access scope. Business coach, career mentor and lawyer do not automatically have access. R17 is unavailable until that contract producer exists.
producer_contract.licensing: A completed content/merchandising activity can create licensable content or royalty rights only when its approved deliverable names those rights. No generic business purchase invents intellectual property. Y08/Y09 unavailable without rights.
producer_contract.perk: Y12 stores perk_id and tax_recorded=false, then actual delivery sets tax_recorded=true and recognizes30k noncash NIL income. R16 applies only to another explicitly authored perk producer that has deferred tax recognition; never repeat theY12 tax.
producer_contract.academic: A simulated academic review task can set academic_risk when its disclosed deadline is missed. Until that task exists B07 is ineligible; never randomize a bad grade because another blue card is unavailable.
producer_contract.release_gate: Every scenario must have a supported producer and ledger handler before a production manifest enables it. Recommended-preview availability does not assert deployed reachability. Missing predicates fail closed and may yield All clear. Unsupported fields must not be guessed by AI.
